description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Switch Draw Mode II (Ice, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Frostshade Witch Mode I (Edea)] and [(Ice/Dark) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Frostshade Witch Mode I (Edea)
description.text: Ice and Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, causes [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] after using two equipped Ice or Dark abilities, grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user after using two equipped Ice or Dark abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Frostshade Witch Mode II (Edea)], removes [Dual Awoken Frostshade Witch Mode I (Edea)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Frostshade Witch Mode II (Edea)
description.text: Increase the damage/healing cap by 10000, Ice and Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00, grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)], [Buff Dark 10% (15s)] and [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using Ice and Dark abilities

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Dark 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Switch Draw Mode II (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Ice/Dark ability

description.name: (Ice/Dark) Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Ice and Dark abilities deal 5% more damage
